purpose: Define the senior-quant alpha framework that will drive S&P 500 ticker selection. SPY is the benchmark and market-regime proxy, NOT the trading universe. The real universe is S&P 500 equities; the model must ultimately rank tickers and propose BUY / SELL / HOLD / AVOID candidates. This document is the contract that Phase 5-C will implement. Nothing here is trained, deployed, or executed.
trading_universe: S&P 500 equities (constituents resolved from local universe artifacts; SPY itself is excluded from ranking)

market_regime_layer.description: How SPY / S&P 500 regime conditions the cross-sectional ticker selection. The regime is computed ONCE per scoring date from the SPY proxy and then modulates exposure, ranking aggressiveness, and action thresholds for every ticker.

features.definition: SPY trailing 20-session return.

features.name: spy_price_vs_sma_200
features.definition: SPY close relative to its 200d SMA (primary trend gate).

features.name: spy_sma_50_vs_200
features.definition: SPY 50d vs 200d SMA (golden/death-cross proxy).

features.name: spy_realized_vol_21d
features.definition: Annualized std of SPY 21d daily returns.

features.name: spy_realized_vol_percentile

features.name: spy_drawdown_from_peak_252d
features.definition: SPY worst peak-to-trough decline over trailing 252 sessions (<= 0).

features.name: market_regime_score
features.definition: Composite [-1,1] score blending SPY trend, vol percentile, and drawdown into a single risk-on/off gauge.

features.name: market_breadth_advance_decline
features.definition: Share of S&P 500 names above their own 50d/200d SMA (breadth confirmation of the index trend).

features.name: macro_rates_credit_proxy
features.definition: Rates / credit-spread / risk-appetite macro inputs.

how_regime_affects_selection: risk_off (SPY below 200d SMA AND high vol percentile OR deep drawdown) -> reduce long exposure: fewer BUYs, raise BUY threshold, prefer low-beta / defensive ranks, expand AVOID.
risk_on (SPY above 200d SMA AND calm vol AND shallow drawdown) -> normal long exposure: full BUY budget, momentum tilt permitted.
neutral -> reduced conviction: cap position count, widen HOLD band, demand stronger relative strength for BUY.
unknown (insufficient SPY history) -> degrade all actions toward HOLD/INSUFFICIENT_DATA and cap confidence.

cross_sectional_alpha_layer.description: Per-ticker feature families scored cross-sectionally across the S&P 500 universe on each date. Every feature is point-in-time (trailing window only, no look-ahead). Features unavailable from local price history are catalogued as future/missing and degrade safely.

labels.description: Prediction targets the cross-sectional model will optimize and be validated against. All labels are forward-looking and computed only for backtest/validation (never available at scoring time).

catalog.name: forward_excess_return_20d_vs_spy
catalog.definition: 20-session forward return minus SPY 20-session forward return (cross-sectional alpha target).

catalog.name: top_quintile_forward_excess_return_probability
catalog.definition: Binary label: ticker in the top quintile of forward 20d excess return on the date.

catalog.name: bottom_quintile_downside_classification
catalog.definition: Binary label: ticker in the bottom quintile of forward 20d excess return (downside / avoid candidates).

catalog.name: downside_risk_probability
catalog.definition: Binary label: forward drawdown / loss beyond a threshold (e.g. <= -8% peak-to-trough over the horizon).

model_families.description: Staged model families with explicit promotion evidence. Stage 1 is the only deployable model in Phase 5-C; later stages require the validation gates to pass before being used.

stage_1_baseline_deployable.name: cross_sectional_composite_zscore
stage_1_baseline_deployable.appropriate_when: First operational version: transparent, auditable, no fitted coefficients, fully reproducible offline.
stage_1_baseline_deployable.evidence_required: Positive rank IC on walk-forward holdout and a positive top-minus-bottom decile spread before it informs any preview ranking.

stage_2_statistical.name: regularized_linear_models
stage_2_statistical.appropriate_when: After the baseline shows edge and a clean walk-forward harness exists; used to fit feature weights with shrinkage and to produce a calibrated top-quintile probability.
stage_2_statistical.evidence_required: Out-of-sample rank IC >= baseline, stable coefficients across folds, calibrated probabilities (Brier/log-loss improvement vs baseline).

stage_3_later_candidates.name: advanced_models
stage_3_later_candidates.appropriate_when: Only after Stage 2 demonstrates durable, cost-surviving edge and there is enough data to avoid overfitting; each adds capacity but also overfit/operational risk.
stage_3_later_candidates.evidence_required: Material, statistically credible out-of-sample improvement over Stage 2 that survives transaction costs, turnover limits, and regime robustness; documented feature-importance stability and drift monitoring.

scoring_design.description: How a ticker receives its score, rank, expected return, confidence, action, reason codes, and risk flags.

per_ticker_outputs.definition: Cross-sectional composite alpha in [-1, 1] (regime-adjusted) before ranking.
Universe percentile rank (0..1) of signal_score on the date; drives candidate selection.
Horizon expected return proxy; conservative and clearly labelled as uncalibrated until Stage 2.
Heuristic strength/coverage gauge in [0,1], capped (0.60) while calibration is limited.
One of BUY, SELL, HOLD, AVOID, INSUFFICIENT_DATA.
List of machine-readable codes explaining the action (e.g. TREND_UP, RS_TOP_DECILE, REGIME_RISK_OFF, LIQUIDITY_FAIL).
List of risk warnings (e.g. HIGH_VOL, DEEP_DRAWDOWN, LOW_LIQUIDITY, HIGH_BETA_IN_RISK_OFF).

action_rules.BUY: High rank_score (e.g. top decile/quintile) AND positive regime-adjusted signal_score AND passes liquidity gate AND not blocked by risk flags; in risk_off the BUY threshold is raised and the BUY budget shrinks.
action_rules.SELL: Applies to an existing (paper) long: signal_score has turned negative / rank has collapsed / a hard risk flag fired -> preview recommendation to exit or trim the position. No short selling is implied; SELL never opens a new short.
action_rules.HOLD: Mid-rank or already-held names with no decisive signal: neither strong enough to BUY nor weak enough to SELL/AVOID; default in neutral regime and for marginal scores.
action_rules.AVOID: Do NOT initiate: low/negative rank_score, failed liquidity gate, or severe risk flags; the do-not-touch bucket for new exposure.
action_rules.INSUFFICIENT_DATA: Not enough point-in-time history/features to score the ticker (or universe/regime unknown); never guessed.

scoring_design.regime_exposure_rules: risk_off reduces long exposure (raises BUY threshold, caps number of BUYs, tilts toward low-beta, widens AVOID). risk_on permits the full BUY budget and a momentum tilt. neutral caps conviction and widens HOLD.
scoring_design.confidence_capping_rule: Confidence is capped at 0.60 while calibration_status is limited (no out-of-sample probability calibration). Missing features, unknown regime, or thin liquidity further reduce confidence. Confidence never advertises probabilistic precision the model has not earned.

validation_methodology.description: Senior-quant validation that must be run before the model is trusted for preview ranking, and again before any later promotion. Designed to detect leakage, regime fragility, and cost-fragility — the usual ways a backtest lies.

methods.name: walk_forward_validation
methods.definition: Expanding/rolling out-of-sample windows; never fit and evaluate on the same period.

methods.name: purged_embargoed_splits
methods.definition: Purge label-overlap windows and embargo around test folds to prevent horizon leakage.

methods.name: rank_ic
methods.definition: Spearman rank correlation between predicted score and realized forward excess return, cross-sectionally per date.

methods.name: ic_by_year
methods.definition: Rank IC broken out per calendar year (stability over time).

methods.name: ic_by_regime
methods.definition: Rank IC broken out by SPY risk_on / risk_off / neutral regime (does edge survive risk_off?).

methods.name: top_minus_bottom_decile_spread
methods.definition: Forward-return spread between top and bottom decile of the score (long/short readability of the signal).

methods.name: top_quintile_hit_rate
methods.definition: Fraction of top-quintile picks that beat SPY over the horizon.

methods.name: turnover
methods.definition: Average fraction of the book that changes per rebalance (cost/operational load).

methods.name: transaction_cost_survival
methods.definition: Does the decile spread / IC edge survive realistic per-trade costs and slippage?

methods.name: max_drawdown
methods.definition: Worst peak-to-trough of the simulated long(/short) portfolio.

methods.name: volatility_sharpe_caveat
methods.definition: Report Sharpe with explicit caveats (non-normal returns, limited sample, no compounding guarantees).

methods.name: sector_concentration
methods.definition: Exposure concentration by sector to avoid an unintended single-bet.

methods.name: beta_exposure
methods.definition: Net beta to SPY of the selected book (especially in risk_off).

methods.name: liquidity_capacity_check
methods.definition: Are picks tradable at assumed size given dollar volume?

methods.name: feature_stability
methods.definition: Stability of feature importance / weights across folds (overfit detector).

methods.name: confidence_calibration
methods.definition: Reliability of confidence vs realized hit rate (Brier/log-loss, reliability curve).

methods.name: shadow_trading_capture
methods.definition: Capture preview picks live (no orders) and compare to realized outcomes before any execution is ever considered.

acceptance_gates.description: Go/No-Go gates. Implementation gates must pass before Phase 5-C wires the model into any preview ranking; deployment gates must pass before GCP serving; execution gates must pass before any (paper, then live) execution is even discussed. A gate that cannot be evaluated yet is recorded as NOT_YET_EVALUATED and blocks promotion (never silently passed).

gates.threshold: not strongly negative in risk_off; edge not concentrated in one regime
no look-ahead / no label leakage confirmed
every feature traces to real local data or is marked missing; nothing fabricated
documented shadow-trading capture period with acceptable hit rate before any live execution is considered

implementation_contract.description: The exact public functions Phase 5-C must build in research/model_v2_pricing_engine, with their required response schemas. score_market_v2 and score_ticker_v2 already exist (Phase 5-A); 5-C adds the cross-sectional ranking and candidate generation on top of the same package.

functions.name: score_ticker_v2
functions.purpose: Score a single ticker's cross-sectional alpha and action (extends the Phase 5-A directional payload with signal_score/rank_score context, action, reason_codes, risk_flags).

response_schema.rank_score: float|null (0..1, may be null when scored in isolation)

functions.name: rank_universe_v2
functions.purpose: Score the full S&P 500 universe cross-sectionally on the latest date, apply the SPY regime overlay, and return tickers ranked by rank_score.

response_schema.rankings: list[ {ticker, signal_score, rank_score, action, confidence, reason_codes, risk_flags} ] sorted by rank_score desc

functions.name: generate_trade_candidates_v2
functions.purpose: From the ranked universe, derive the preview BUY / SELL / HOLD / AVOID candidate lists under the current regime, honouring exposure and liquidity gates.

response_schema.buy_candidates: list[ {ticker, rank_score, signal_score, confidence, reason_codes, risk_flags} ]
response_schema.exposure_note: str (how regime limited the BUY budget)

future_gcp_endpoints.description: Preview-only endpoints to be added in Phase 5-D / 5-E (NOT implemented now). All are GET, read-only, flag-gated, and return preview payloads with orders/broker/automation disabled.
